{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured blouse in soft linen blend with a slight puff sleeve, crisp white, color #FFFFFF, medium weight.
High-waisted trousers in dark washed denim with a straight leg, indigo, color #191970, sturdy cotton twill.
Minimalist gold bar necklace on a thin chain, polished brass, color #FFD700, lightweight metal.
Round-toe loafers in smooth leather, oxblood, color #5D1414, supple calf skin.
This outfit balances the warmth of an autumn evening with the elegance required for a dinner date at 19:30 while maintaining a relaxed yet polished aesthetic. The dark denim elevates the look beyond everyday casual wear, creating a sophisticated base that feels effortless and confident in a restaurant setting. Adding a subtle gold accent keeps the focus on your style without being overly formal or stiff for a first date."}
